name: ai-towing-receptionist
description: Multi-tenant AI receptionist for towing companies. Never miss a towing lead again.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @towai/shared && npm run build -w @towai/api
scripts.setup: npm run build -w @towai/shared && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.test: npm run test -w @towai/shared && npm run test -w @towai/api
scripts.start:api: npm run build -w @towai/shared && npm run build -w @towai/api && node apps/api/dist/main.js
